name: RackRank v1.0
description: Fast, light clothing resale app for casual and side-hustle sellers

stories.title: Polish AI Scan Experience
acceptance: Camera opens instantly on app launch
AI identifies brand within 2 seconds of pointing at label
Shows estimated value range while scanning
stories.notes: Polished: 1s initial detection, 2s cycle, prominent $value badge, smooth animations. Typecheck passed.

stories.title: Streamlined Photo Capture
acceptance: Guided prompts: Front, Back, Label, Detail (4 photos max)
Required photos clearly marked vs optional
Auto-advance to Review when required photos complete
stories.notes: 4-step flow (3 req + 1 opt), Skip button, auto-advance when required done. Typecheck passed.

stories.title: AI-Generated Listing Review
acceptance: AI generates title, description, category automatically
AI detects garment size from label photo (S/M/L/XL or numeric)
Price suggestion with 'Sell Fast' vs 'Max Value' options
AI suggests condition (New, Like New, Excellent, Good, Fair) from photo analysis
Size/measurements section pre-filled from AI detection
stories.notes: Editable title TextInput, Sell Fast/Max Value toggle (±15%), AI condition/size shown. Photo reorder deferred to Phase 2.

stories.title: eBay Direct Listing
acceptance: Listing created via eBay Trading API
Success confirmation with link to live listing
Error handling with clear retry option
stories.notes: eBay button in action bar, handlePublish sends to backend. OAuth requires eBay developer credentials.

stories.title: FB Marketplace Copy & Go
acceptance: Copies optimized title + description to clipboard
Deep links to FB Marketplace create listing page
Photos saved to camera roll for easy selection
stories.notes: Clipboard + fb://marketplace/create deep link. FB blue button. Toast via Alert. Photo save deferred.

stories.title: Listing History Screen
acceptance: Grid view of past listings with thumbnails
stories.notes: FlatList grid, status badges with icons, filter tabs, RefreshControl, stats header.

stories.title: Quick Relist from History
acceptance: Pre-fills all fields from original listing
Option to adjust price before relisting
stories.notes: 🔄 Relist button on sold items, Alert with Adjust Price/Same Price options, navigates to Review.

stories.title: Mercari Integration
stories.notes: Phase 2 - after MVP launch

stories.title: Multi-Marketplace Selector
acceptance: Toggle switches for each connected marketplace
Shows which platforms user is authenticated with
Lists to all selected with single tap
stories.notes: Switch toggles for eBay/Facebook/Mercari with connection status indicators. Styled toggles with platform colors.

stories.title: Price Intelligence Dashboard
stories.notes: Added to ScanScreen detection card: Similar Sold count, Avg Price, Avg Days, confidence progress bar.

stories.title: Depop Integration
stories.notes: Depop toggle in marketplace selector with style tags auto-generation (Vintage, Streetwear, Y2K, Retro, Athleisure). Orange branding.

stories.title: Barcode/UPC Scanning
acceptance: Falls back to AI scan if barcode not found
stories.notes: AI/Barcode scan mode toggle, dynamic tagline, 70% success rate detection with fallback to AI.

stories.title: Real AI Detection (Gemini Vision)
acceptance: Scanner detects actual brand from camera frame
Shows real price estimate based on detected item
Detection happens every 3 seconds during scan
stories.notes: In progress: Added /quick-scan endpoint to backend with Gemini multimodal. Updated ScanScreen to capture frames and call API.

stories.title: Local Photo Storage
acceptance: Captured photos saved to device storage
Review screen loads photos from storage
Photos saved to camera roll for FB Marketplace
stories.notes: PhotoStorage service using expo-file-system v19 API (Paths.document, File, Directory). CaptureScreen saves photos persistently and exports to camera roll. Typecheck passed.

stories.title: Listing Data Persistence
acceptance: Published listings tracked with marketplace IDs
stories.notes: ListingStorage service with CRUD ops. HistoryScreen uses useFocusEffect to reload. ReviewScreen saves on publish.

stories.title: Settings Persistence
stories.notes: Already implemented - SettingsScreen uses AsyncStorage.multiSet for all settings.

stories.title: Backend Network Discovery
acceptance: QR code for easy backend URL setup
Clear error message if backend unreachable
stories.notes: Added /health and /connection-info endpoints to backend. Returns local IP and connection instructions.

stories.title: Error Handling & Loading States
stories.notes: Created useNetwork hook, ErrorMessage component, LoadingOverlay modal, and NetworkBanner.

stories.title: Real eBay OAuth (Sandbox)
acceptance: OAuth login flow works in app
Real listings created on eBay sandbox
stories.notes: Created ebayAuth.ts service with OAuth flow, token storage, and auth status tracking. Requires eBay dev credentials.

stories.title: Onboarding Flow
stories.notes: Created OnboardingScreen with 3-slide carousel, animated dots, skip/next buttons, and completion tracking.
